market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed-hike repricing and energy inflation. S&P 500 likely to test support levels as bond yields rise. Oil may sustain $95+ on supply constraints. Expect volatility around CPI data. EM currencies may see pullback if Fed signals further tightening. AI names may consolidate after extended runs.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally supportive for semiconductors and enterprise software. Energy transition (solar, EVs) faces near-term margin pressure but long-term tailwinds intact. De-dollarization trend (Netherlands gold, EM strength, China energy dominance) is multi-year structural shift. Consumer spending recovery delayed by energy and housing costs. Fed policy path remains the dominant macro variable.
